epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce full stack launch and verification time from >15 mins to <1 min
requirements: R1: Add a docker-compose.yml at the repository root that starts the full stack and exposes a health-check endpoint

slices.title: Add docker-compose for full stack execution
slices.jtbd: When implementing the docker-compose setup for this epic, I want to add a docker-compose.yml file exposing a health check, so that the product can be verified as a running stack locally.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a repository without a docker-compose file, When a developer runs docker-compose up, Then the full stack starts successfully.
Given the stack is running, When the automated test pings the health-check, Then it verifies the 200 OK response.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce docker-compose up time from >10 mins to <1 min

epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce outdated material presence time in catalog from >1 day to <1 hour
requirements: R1: Add UI controls and logic to update existing materials via the existing PUT API
R2: Add UI controls and logic to delete existing materials via the existing DELETE API

slices.title: Wire frontend UI for updating and deleting materials
slices.jtbd: When implementing the material update and delete UI for this epic, I want to wire existing PUT and DELETE endpoints to the frontend, so that the knowledge base accurately reflects the most current protocols.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing material, When a user updates or deletes it via the UI, Then the frontend invokes the corresponding API.
Given the new UI elements are implemented, When the frontend E2E test suite runs, Then it successfully simulates user clicks for update and delete.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce manual material deletion/update operation time from >5 mins to <30 secs

epics.title: Authentication and Authorization
epics.jtbd: When accessing the knowledge base, I want to authenticate my identity, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected from unauthorized access or modification.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease unauthorized access incidents to protected protocols from current baseline to 0
requirements: R1: Block unauthenticated access to the catalog and material creation endpoints, prompting to log in

slices.title: Enforce authentication on protected resources
slices.jtbd: When implementing authentication for this epic, I want to block unauthenticated access to the catalog and prompt login, so that restricted data is protected from unauthorized access.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated user, When they attempt to access restricted routes, Then they are blocked and prompted to log in.
Given the access controls are implemented, When the integration test suite runs without credentials, Then it verifies a 401 or 403 response on all protected endpoints.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease unauthorized API requests that bypass security from >0% to 0%
